lines.trans: Good morning again, Madam Helga! Would you like coffee or black tea?
Black tea without sugar, please, and one slice of warm bread.
May I pour you fresh orange juice, madam?
Oh, how kind of you. Just half a glass, please.
In our house, perfect service goes without saying... whoops!
Careful, Martin, the pitcher has a wide spout!
Oh dear! Not a drop on the table... all of it is on my tie!
Do not worry! Cold sparkling water gets orange juice right out.
Here are a clean cloth and cold water, Martin.
Excuse me, madam, I shall retreat to my office with dignity!
Your scrambled eggs are delicious, Klara. Give Miriam high praise!
I will gladly do that! Enjoy your morning.
